contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ DN VALEN

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens. Mint is Arles, AD367-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN VALEN - S PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]CON[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.25g, diameter is 17.59mm
